mission: Deliver one coherent sovereign stack where Rumble products consume Portal, Bolt, Wrench, and Gear through explicit contracts and leave reproducible evidence.

repositories.name: rumble-canvas
repositories.target_role: Product conception workspace that turns discussion into specs and Bolt handoffs.
repositories.target_state: SpecPackage, traceability, waivers, and planning-only handoff are usable through Portal-backed UI.
acceptance: Gear artifact refs are emitted for packages

repositories.name: rumble-cos
repositories.target_role: Public education and explanation surface for ecosystem lessons.
repositories.target_state: Publishes the stack doctrine, release notes, and evidence-backed learning notes without becoming an internal CMS.
acceptance: Rumble Portal Bolt Wrench Gear explanation published

repositories.name: rumble-crew
repositories.target_role: Human and agent teamwork surface with tasks, approvals, blockers, and evidence.
repositories.target_state: Displays Bolt runs and Wrench/Gear evidence with human approval and recovery semantics.
acceptance: raw logs are controlled and TTL-limited

repositories.name: rumble-feed-mind
repositories.target_role: Explainable feed and watch pipeline producing curated reusable knowledge.
repositories.target_state: CuratedItemExport is runtime-backed, BYOK policy is explicit, and reusable parsing flows through Gear Loader.
acceptance: legacy web path is migrated or retired

repositories.name: rumble-lm
repositories.target_role: Source-grounded learning and live facilitation product.
repositories.target_state: Minimal source-grounded live session uses CitationValidation, retention defaults, Gear source flow, Portal UI, and Gear exports.
acceptance: Gear Loader and Gear Memory integrated

repositories.name: rumble-note
repositories.target_role: Local-first personal knowledge and private context export product.
repositories.target_state: Minimal block model and NoteContextExport feed Gear Memory and other Rumble products safely.

repositories.name: rumble-ai-practices
repositories.target_role: Professional AI-practice training product with audited scenarios.
repositories.target_state: Validated content corpus, CLI audit, Portal PWA, and no hidden HR scoring.

repositories.name: portal-forge
repositories.target_role: Compile design tokens into platform artifacts with accessibility validation.
repositories.target_state: DTCG tokens generate CSS, Swift, and Kotlin bundles with contrast reports and versioned outputs.
acceptance: typography spacing radius border shadow motion tokens supported

repositories.name: portal-core
repositories.target_role: Shared Rust client contracts for i18n UI, accessibility, theme, focus, and bindings.
repositories.target_state: Rust contracts are consumed by Apple, Android, and at least one Rumble client fixture.

repositories.name: portal-apple
repositories.target_role: SwiftUI adapter for Portal contracts and tokens.
repositories.target_state: Minimal SwiftUI shell consumes Portal core and generated tokens.

repositories.name: portal-android
repositories.target_role: Jetpack Compose adapter for Portal contracts and tokens.
repositories.target_state: Minimal Compose shell consumes Portal core and generated tokens with reproducible local SDK proof.
acceptance: Android SDK NDK build proof exists

repositories.name: bolt-cos-matic
repositories.target_role: Deterministic planning and policy-gated orchestration engine.
repositories.target_state: Consumes Rumble handoffs and Wrench/Gear evidence refs, refuses unsafe plans, and gates trusted execution.
acceptance: evidence refs are mandatory for sensitive plans

repositories.name: bolt-harness
repositories.target_role: Public sandbox and evidence bench for Bolt behavior.
repositories.target_state: Runs scrubbed scenarios covering Portal build, Gear Loader hostile source, Wrench refusal, and Gear artifact proof.

repositories.name: wrench-inspect
repositories.target_role: General inspection and evidence report engine.
repositories.target_state: Produces EvidenceReport for specs, Portal UI checks, privacy, sovereignty, browser, and citation validation.

repositories.name: wrench-db-inspect
repositories.target_role: Database security inspection for Postgres-backed products.
repositories.target_state: Strict DB gates check RLS, grants, migrations, pgvector, and tenant isolation from a manifest.

repositories.name: gear-loader
repositories.target_role: Runtime-capable canonical ingestion and parser-policy substrate.
repositories.target_state: Extracts approved source types into canonical documents, hostile-content evidence, and GearSourceCandidate handoff.
acceptance: PDF and Office fail-closed or approved parsers are sandboxed
GearSourceCandidate is accepted by Gear Memory

repositories.name: gear-memory
repositories.target_state: Persists SourceRef, MemoryEntry, EventLogEntry, CodeMap, and ProvenanceRecord with indexes and privacy controls.

repositories.name: gear-depot
repositories.target_role: Artifact manifest, policy, cache, verification, and distribution trust.
repositories.target_state: Verifies exported packages, reports, releases, and manifests with retention and revocation metadata.

repositories.name: gear-cable
repositories.target_role: Release planning and reproducible distribution wiring.
repositories.target_state: Connects release plans to Depot manifests and proves at least one desktop/mobile/tool release path.
acceptance: release plan to Depot manifest works
App Store adapter path is proven when needed

milestones.name: Control plane complete
milestones.goal: Keep doctrine, names, maturity schemas, and target version contracts coherent.

milestones.name: Portal proof
milestones.goal: Prove Portal tokens/core/adapters through one Rumble client fixture.
acceptance: one web or native Rumble shell uses Portal

milestones.name: Gear source path
milestones.goal: Prove Gear Loader to Gear Memory source and provenance flow.

milestones.name: Wrench evidence
milestones.goal: Prove Wrench inspection reports over specs, Portal surfaces, and Gear Loader outputs.
acceptance: Gear Loader evidence can be inspected

milestones.name: Bolt gated planning
milestones.goal: Prove Rumble handoff planning with evidence refs and structured refusals.

milestones.name: First end-to-end Rumble slice
milestones.goal: Ship one real product slice using Portal, Gear, Wrench, and Bolt boundaries.
acceptance: Bolt handoff exists or is explicitly not needed

milestones.name: Native and release proof
milestones.goal: Prove native client and reproducible release path without duplicating product logic.
acceptance: Apple or Android shell consumes Portal
Gear Cable release plan links to Depot

system_acceptance: At least one real Rumble product uses Portal for UI tokens and accessibility.
At least one source flow runs Gear Loader to Gear Memory with provenance.
At least one exported product artifact is represented by Gear Depot manifest data.
At least one release plan is connected through Gear Cable when distribution is needed.
Wrench evidence exists for the chosen product slice.
Bolt can validate or refuse a planning-only handoff using evidence refs.
Rumble Cos or an equivalent learning note explains the slice and links to evidence.
non_goals: Do not merge all repositories into one monorepo as a default answer.
Do not let Gear Depot absorb Portal UI semantics.
Do not let Wrench own runtime ingestion or durable truth.
Do not activate Bolt trusted execution before evidence and approval gates are proven.
Do not duplicate product logic in SwiftUI or Compose shells.
